Prototype 8 encodes N2 (100% pure) primarily through EEG (84%), with EOG (12%) and EMG (5%) contribution.
Its EEG signature shows elevated δ (+8.5 dB, sensitivity=5.9) and elevated σ_h (+8.3 dB, sensitivity=5.0).
The δ activity is present in 66% of each epoch (intermittent), with active eye movements (SEM 66% active (likely EEG crosstalk)) and tonic muscle tone.
This is partially coherent with N2 physiology: confirmed: σ elevated, σ relevant; missing: EOG quiescent.
